name: Vitamin K2 (menaquinone-7)

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A long-chain bacterial menaquinone form of vitamin K, a cofactor for gamma-carboxylation of osteocalcin and matrix Gla protein. Taken alongside vitamin D for calcium handling.

systems.note: Gamma-carboxylation of bone and vascular Gla proteins; the intended effect.
Directly antagonises vitamin K antagonist anticoagulation; a clinically consequential interaction.

monitors.why: The bone endpoint the supplement is taken for.
Read alongside vitamin D when both are taken for calcium handling.
